title: ESA WorldCover 2021
attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
qualification: Categorical RGB visualization of the 2021 land-cover product, not pixel-value analysis or a live observation. Projected service extent is not a promise of valid data everywhere. Transparent pixels and the pinned empty-image sentinel indicate no source classification.

service.authentication: Public map layer; browser requests omit credentials.
service.identity: Versioned provider imagery; sample hashes record observed bytes, not immutable future responses.
service.conditions: Use must not degrade open services or adversely affect other users. The reviewed terms give no numeric request quota or uninterrupted-service guarantee. Bound requests and handle unavailability.

legend.qualification: The official 2021 data-access page links this standard symbology in its v100 documentation directory. All opaque pixels in the ten admitted sample tiles match these eleven colors.

geometry.qualification: Existing imagery and map layers share the same Web Mercator matrix, 256-pixel tiles and row/column orientation. Reuse geographic frames; imagery coverage and no-data must be evaluated separately. This does not certify all source pixels or whole-globe overview rendering.
